scope: Simple public-player analytics; local installation only
implemented: One opening per public iframe load, with idempotent delivery retries
Cumulative visible session time and average per opening
One editable 1–5 rating per account and publication
Feed average rating and sorting by mean, vote count, recency

completion_counter.reason: Deferred with owner permission; existing games have no reliable universal win signal

generation.collection_location: Publication viewer, outside the sandboxed game iframe

browser.type: Real Chromium with inert fixture game and mocked APIs in OS sandbox
browser.final_landscape_layout: Decorative phone controls stay within the frame; statistics begins 30px below it

data_preservation.existing_publications_and_likes_preserva: Covered by database regression tests; local live database had none

local_health: App, guest session and built UI returned HTTP 200 after update
limitations: Time measures visible viewing, not continuous active input
Final delivery is best effort; network interruption can undercount time
Session lifetime is limited to one hour; no unique-user or anti-fraud claim
Historical activity is not reconstructed; existing likes are not converted into stars
